commuting-riverton.title: Commuting by car, bus and bicycle in Riverton (1990–2020)
commuting-riverton.overview: Car travel remained the leading commuting mode but declined after reaching a peak in 2005, whereas cycling rose sharply towards the end. Bus use fell overall before recovering slightly.
